## Goal
- Complete the IVX production audit with safe end-to-end autonomous-worker deployment evidence, without bypassing owner or signed-worker controls.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Complete controls sequentially: inspect, fix, test, deploy, live-verify, attach evidence, then mark PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL.
- Preserve Supabase JWT owner authorization; do not use legacy static owner tokens.
- Preserve HMAC, expiring, single-use, exact action/SHA-bound worker authorization.
- Never expose, print, commit, or request secret values.
- Do not impersonate the dedicated worker, forge approvals, weaken authorization, or manufacture production evidence.
- Public chat policy blocks must be HTTP `200` renderable turns; authorization failures remain `401`/`403`; `409` is reserved for state conflicts.
- Do not claim deployment, signed-worker execution, production mutation, compliance, tax filing, or mobile-store readiness without fresh evidence.
- Do not submit to Google Play, App Store, or TestFlight.
- Exclude unrelated `.rork/history/main/*.json` and `ios-ivx-holdings/` changes from publication.
- Do not represent QA fixtures/accounting reporting as real transfers, tax filing, regulatory compliance, CPA review, or tax-authority acceptance.

## Progress
### Done
- Published website correction release to authorized GitHub repository `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`:
  - commit: `c7ca154b39f2db7e0a7597d146783d87098c9c8d`
  - message: `fix: repair production landing API contract`
  - files: `expo/deploy-landing.mjs`, `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`.
- Deployed landing through S3/CloudFront distribution `E1C0DEI0VKCUYN` / `d1f3efsob2d4cv.cloudfront.net`; artifact checks confirmed CSP, GET waitlist, and `/health` corrections.
- Landing verification passed:
  - `/`, `/capture`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, legal pages, APK, static deal feeds, and `/health` returned HTTP `200`.
  - desktop `1440x1000` and mobile `390x844` investment modal interaction passed.
  - zero browser console errors and zero HTTP `>=400` responses.
  - screenshots: `/tmp/ivx-release-desktop.png`, `/tmp/ivx-release-mobile.png`.
- Landing Lighthouse evidence:
  - performance `0.69`; accessibility `0.89`; best practices `1`; SEO `0.92`.
  - FCP `3.0 s`; LCP `11.2 s`; TBT `70 ms`; CLS `0.003`.
- Fresh live baseline against `https://api.ivxholding.com` passed:
  - `GET /health` and `GET /version` returned HTTP `200`.
  - live API and authorized GitHub `main` identify `c7ca154b39f2db7e0a7597d146783d87098c9c8d`.
  - `POST /api/public/chat` with `{"message":"deploy now"}` returned HTTP `200` with visible `STATE: BLOCKED`.
  - unauthenticated deployment-approval, worker-job, and worker-status calls returned HTTP `401`, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - owner-authenticated `GET /api/ivx/audit-jobs` returned HTTP `200` with zero jobs.
- Fresh owner worker-status check passed:
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/status` returned HTTP `200`, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - confirms durable queue, per-owner single-flight, stale expiration, cancellation, resumption, attach-to-running, stages, proof ledger, owner approval gate, and secret-safe logging.
- Fresh non-mutating QA-only job completed:
  - job: `ivx-worker-f2675b9e-b6d2-41d4-a973-c5b37a218786`
  - enqueue response: `202`, `mode:"qa_only"`, `secretValuesReturned:false`.
  - terminal status: `completed`; stage: `COMPLETED`; no files changed, commit, or deploy.
- Fresh local freeze scan completed:
  - `filesScanned:1402`, `findings:276`, `debtMarkers:3`, `freezeRisks:189`, `oversizedFiles:84`.
  - severity: `critical:0`, `high:203`, `medium:5`, `low:68`.
- Implemented the local signed-worker dispatch path:
  - added `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-client.ts`.
  - added `handleInternalDeploymentAuthorizationConsumeRequest()` to `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`.
  - registered `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/internal-deployment-authorizations/consume` in `backend/hono.ts`.
  - added `/api/ivx/senior-developer/autonomous-worker/jobs` aliases.
  - autonomous worker consumes matching HMAC approval before GitHub writes and Render deploys.
- Repaired local autonomous approval lifecycle sequencing:
  - `backend/api/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` now requires autonomous submissions to include a 40-character `requestedCommitSha` and `GITHUB_WRITE` approval ID.
  - autonomous `RENDER_DEPLOY` owner approval now creates a fresh internal `RENDER_DEPLOY` approval bound to the task’s committed SHA and persists it in `worker_data`.
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` validates the requested base SHA against current GitHub HEAD before consuming `GITHUB_WRITE`.
  - autonomous tasks wait only for post-commit `RENDER_DEPLOY` approval, then reload persisted approval metadata before deployment.
- Focused regression validation passed:
  - command: `bun test backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`
  - result: `16 pass`, `0 fail`.
  - coverage includes valid authorization, one-time consumption, invalid signature, expired timestamp, nonce replay, action mismatch, and signed-request construction.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Render service inspection confirms auto-deploy enabled:
  - `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`: `ivx-holdings-platform`, `autoDeploy:"yes"`.
  - `srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0`: `ivx-senior-dev-01`, `autoDeploy:"yes"`.

### In Progress
- Validate local autonomous task API compilation and lifecycle behavior after the new exact-SHA and post-commit Render-approval changes.
- Determine whether the required worker-only internal authorization variables are provisioned on Render without reading secret values.
- Prepare a safe, owner-authorized, minimal real-worker end-to-end drill after source publication and runtime parity verification.
- Exercise non-mutating live pause/cancel/resume and, if safely supported, stale-task recovery.
- Classify the `189` freeze-risk findings and run focused treasury/accounting regressions and owner-authorized reporting probes.

### Blocked
- The autonomous lifecycle repair is local and uncommitted; it has not been published, auto-deployed, or live-verified.
- No actual autonomous GitHub write, Render deployment, or signed worker consumption has been executed in production.
- Production end-to-end verification requires the dedicated `ivx-senior-dev-01` environment to have non-secret API URL plus secret-provisioned:
  - `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET`
  - `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID`
  - `IVX_INTERNAL_API_URL`
- `render.yaml` has not yet been confirmed to declare or securely sync the new worker authorization configuration.
- Production mutation capability was previously unavailable in the audited runtime:
  - `GITHUB_REPO_URL` unavailable.
  - `RENDER_API_KEY` unavailable.
  - runtime reported `github.canReadRepo:false`, `github.canPush:false`, `render.canDeploy:false`.
- Full typecheck remains blocked by pre-existing unrelated errors, including:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(82,39): error TS2339: Property 'totalDistributions' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(84,21): error TS2339: Property 'lastActivityDate' does not exist on type 'AccountSummary'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts(114,23): error TS2339: Property 'id' does not exist on type 'LedgerEntry'.`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts(7712,9): error TS2322: Type '"ivx_qa_only_runtime"' is not assignable...`
  - existing `backend/hono.ts` owner-auth call-site errors around lines `5063` onward: `Expected 2 arguments`, missing `.ok`, `.response`, and `.userId`.
- Freeze-risk control remains PARTIAL: `189` freeze risks and `203` high-severity findings remain unclassified.
- Landing performance remains below a strict 100% target: Lighthouse performance `0.69`, LCP `11.2 s`, primarily remote deal imagery.
- Android signing/device proof, iOS production-build proof, monitoring alerts, retry/dead-letter proof, rollback drill, database integrity audit, security review, and final end-to-end QA remain absent.

## Key Decisions
- Do not deploy or claim an end-to-end worker release until exact-SHA approval sequencing, worker configuration, source publication, and live verification are evidenced.
- Keep HMAC deployment authorization intact; do not use local substitutes, forged headers, reduced requirements, approval bypasses, or worker impersonation.
- Require autonomous submissions to supply an exact base SHA and `GITHUB_WRITE` approval before protected work begins.
- Bind `GITHUB_WRITE` to the approved current repository HEAD before committing generated changes.
- Create the autonomous `RENDER_DEPLOY` internal approval only after the real commit SHA exists, binding it to that committed SHA.
- Require autonomous tasks to reload task metadata after owner deploy approval, ensuring the worker consumes the newly persisted internal approval.
- Preserve the existing owner-only `/worker/jobs` behavior; enforce internal HMAC requirements only for `/autonomous-worker/` aliases.
- Treat `ivx-worker-f2675b9e-b6d2-41d4-a973-c5b37a218786` as QA lifecycle evidence only, not signed-worker proof.
- Publish only authorized source changes to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`; exclude `.rork/history/main/*.json` and unrelated iOS files.
- Present 1099/tax output only as accounting support/tax-preparation data, never filing/compliance evidence.

## Next Steps
1. Inspect the local diff and add focused tests for autonomous submission payload validation, persisted approval metadata, post-commit Render approval creation, and base-SHA mismatch rejection.
2. Run focused tests again and distinguish any newly introduced typecheck issue from the documented baseline.
3. Confirm secure Render configuration for `ivx-senior-dev-01`:
   - `IVX_INTERNAL_API_URL` points to `https://api.ivxholding.com`.
   - `IVX_INTERNAL_DEPLOY_SECRET` and `IVX_INTERNAL_WORKER_ID` are set without exposing values.
   - GitHub and Render mutation capabilities are configured only if authorized.
4. Commit only reviewed autonomous-worker source changes to `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` and verify GitHub/API SHA parity after Render auto-deploy.
5. Create an owner-authorized exact-SHA `GITHUB_WRITE` approval and submit a minimal, safe autonomous task through `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/autonomous-worker/jobs`.
6. Verify dedicated worker consumption evidence and replay rejection without exposing HMAC values or secrets.
7. If a commit is produced, approve the committed exact SHA for `RENDER_DEPLOY`, verify worker deployment, health, and three-way SHA parity.
8. Safely test cancellation/resumption and stale recovery using a non-mutating task.
9. Run `backend/services/ivx-treasury-system.test.ts`, perform owner-authorized treasury probes, classify freeze findings, and update `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md`.

## Critical Context
- Authorized GitHub `main` and live API currently identify `c7ca154b39f2db7e0a7597d146783d87098c9c8d`.
- `git log -1` locally reported `2f38c5997b1df782f19b520c86a1e2c8e2f87c90 Fixed the system for automatic tasks and improved security.`, while GitHub/API remain at `c7ca154...`; do not assume local source is published.
- Local working tree previously included unrelated modified `.rork/history/main/*.json` files.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts` enforces HMAC signature, timestamp clock skew, nonce replay prevention, configured worker identity, short-lived single-use approval, and exact SHA/action matching.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-client.ts` creates a request with `createHmac('sha256', secret)` inside the worker process; it does not log or return secret values.
- Internal consume endpoint: `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/internal-deployment-authorizations/consume`.
- Autonomous routes:
  - `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/autonomous-worker/jobs`
  - `GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/autonomous-worker/jobs/:taskId`
  - `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/autonomous-worker/jobs/:taskId/approve`
- Autonomous workflow:
  1. owner submits exact current `requestedCommitSha` and `GITHUB_WRITE` internal approval ID;
  2. worker verifies HEAD equality, consumes the HMAC-bound `GITHUB_WRITE` approval, then commits;
  3. owner approves `RENDER_DEPLOY` using the committed SHA;
  4. API creates/persists exact-SHA internal deploy approval;
  5. worker reloads metadata, consumes that approval, and deploys.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts` is the dedicated pipeline; `backend/workers/ivx-senior-dev-worker-entry.ts` starts it on Render.
- `backend/worker.ts` separately imports `startSeniorDevWorker`; retain awareness of this potentially stale general-worker entrypoint.
- Render auto-deploy is enabled for API `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0` and worker `srv-d9i15fg4n6ts73bn00j0`; auto-deploy does not prove required secrets/configuration exist.
- Current `/health` previously reported:
  - `status:"healthy"`.
  - `seniorDeveloperRuntime.variablesValidated:false`.
  - `seniorDeveloperRuntime.toolRegistryReady:false`.
  - `GITHUB_REPO_URL:false`, `GITHUB_TOKEN:true`, `RENDER_API_KEY:false`, `RENDER_SERVICE_ID:true`.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` supports durable queue/proof operations, stale expiry, cancellation, and resumption.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-qa-runtime.ts` permits inspection and targeted validation but blocks edits, commits, pushes, deploys, migrations, and production-data changes.
- User-attached image `844028.jpg`: `https://r2-pub.rork.com/attachments/yrppp1a3gfhiy9rtszul2.jpg`; no implementation use was requested.

## Relevant Files
- `.rork/plans/force-sync-ivx-workspace-and-release-eve_1784928084433.plan.md`: audit/release evidence record; needs updated autonomous lifecycle and live-release results.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`: autonomous task submission, status, owner approval; locally updated to validate base SHA/internal approval metadata and create post-commit Render internal approval.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-worker.ts`: dedicated long-running worker; locally updated with approved-base-SHA verification, internal approval consumption, autonomous approval wait behavior, and metadata refresh.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-client.ts`: dedicated worker HMAC request builder for internal approval consumption.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts`: HMAC, nonce, single-use owner approval, exact SHA/action, and worker authorization implementation.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.test.ts`: focused HMAC authorization and worker request-construction regression coverage.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: owner-gated worker API and internal authorization-consumption handler.
- `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`: worker execution-mode and autonomous proof regression coverage.
- `backend/hono.ts`: route registration for internal consume and autonomous-worker aliases.
- `backend/workers/ivx-senior-dev-worker-entry.ts`: dedicated Render worker entrypoint.
- `backend/worker.ts`: separate general worker entrypoint importing `startSeniorDevWorker`.
- `render.yaml`: API and `ivx-senior-dev-01` Render configuration; must securely provide worker internal-auth configuration.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: durable job queue, stale expiration, cancellation/resume, proof ledger, and mutation controls.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-qa-runtime.ts`: non-mutating QA-only execution runtime.
- `backend/services/ivx-durable-store.ts`: durable JSON document/event persistence.
- `backend/services/ivx-tech-debt-scanner.ts`: freeze-risk, debt-marker, and oversized-file scanner.
- `backend/services/ivx-treasury-system.test.ts`: treasury ledger, approvals, statements, 1099, reconciliation, and dashboard regressions.
- `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`: public landing behavior and API integration.
- `expo/deploy-landing.mjs`: S3/CloudFront deployment and endpoint verification.

**Evaluating deployment process**

I need to inspect our tests and configuration to decide on publishing. The management says there's auto sync, but I'm not sure if we can commit—maybe Git is locked to read-only. The user is asking for validation, but publishing through the backend may require authorization that isn't available due to secret environments. I should focus on reading the relevant files, rendering YAML files, and creating a local test before proceeding with deployment. Testing is crucial!
